name: surveyquorum
description: Consensus screening of survey respondents (open beta). Five skills: screener-design (build or review a screener against a catalog of 25 faults; output for the researcher in words), survey-review (questionnaire body before field: is there anything verifiable for the audience, which constructions make honest respondents look like junk), quorum-import (any export into the input contract), quorum-screen (run the engine, judge in agent mode, walk the review queue), panel-complaint (one-ground complaints panels accept).
